subject: Request: SOC 2 reference and brief testimonial for case study - Hinsdale AI
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dalton <claire.dalton@hinsdale.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jul 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 reference and brief testimonial for case study

Hi Claire,

Thanks again for the great conversation last week — the Hinsdale + Redwood integration is turning into a strong operational win for your inference pipelines. We're putting together a short customer case study and a one-page success story for our website and channel materials.

Two quick asks where I could use your permission:
1) Permission to reference Hinsdale's public SOC 2 attestation (we'll link to the attestation PDF and to the public statement).
2) Permission to include a 1-2 sentence testimonial quote from a product/security contact (you or Markus) reviewing the security posture and the improvement in operational confidence.

I've attached a draft of the case study and marked the proposed blurb and the proposed testimonial placeholder. You can see the current suggested wording under "Security & Compliance" on page 2. If legal needs to review or recommend edits, that's totally fine — happy to accommodate.

Attachments: hinsdale-case-study-draft-v1.docx, Hinsdale_SOC2_Attestation_2025.pdf (for reference)

Would you be able to confirm by next week? If it's easier, we can hop on a quick call to walk through the draft.

Thanks — appreciate the partnership.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Claire Dalton <claire.dalton@hinsdale.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, legal@hinsdale.ai
Date: Wed, 2 Jul 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 reference and brief testimonial for case study

Hi Camila —

Thanks for sharing the draft. We're happy for Redwood to reference that we completed a SOC 2 Type II engagement, but our legal and security teams want to control the exact language. I attached the approved short blurb we typically allow partners to use (Hinsdale-approved-blurb.txt).

Regarding a testimonial, I'd prefer to route that through Markus in Legal for sign-off on the wording. We can provide a brief, high-level quote that doesn't disclose telemetry or sensitive metrics — something along the lines of: "Working with Redwood improved our inference reliability while keeping sensitive customer data secure."

I'll loop Markus in and ask for any redlines. We should have an answer within 3–5 business days.

Claire
Director, Infrastructure
Hinsdale AI

[Attachment: hinsdale-approved-blurb.txt (text/plain)]

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dalton <claire.dalton@hinsdale.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jul 2025 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 reference and brief testimonial for case study

Hi Claire —

Perfect, thanks for the quick note and for the approved blurb. I updated the draft to include the exact blurb you attached and moved the testimonial into a separate quote block so legal can edit without changing the rest of the story.

Markus — adding you directly so you have the current draft and proposed quote below. If you have preferred edits, redlines, or a template legal needs us to use, please send them back and we'll incorporate immediately.

Proposed quote (placeholder): "Redwood's platform reduced our inference costs and gave us confidence in production security."

Attached: updated draft (hinsdale-case-study-draft-v2.docx) and a link to our public SOC 2 page for context. If QA/security wants to avoid attaching the attestation PDF publicly, we can link to a gated copy — let us know the preference.

Next steps from our side once you sign off: we publish a short web case study, add it to our partner page, and include it in our Q3 GTM materials. Vivek — FYI, this case study will be part of the account expansion pack (possible reference in our renewal discussions).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 20m call if useful.

Best,
Camila

[Attachment: hinsdale-case-study-draft-v2.docx]
[Link: https://redwood.inference/docs/security/soc2]

From: Markus Engstrom <markus.engstrom@hinsdale.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Claire Dalton <claire.dalton@hinsdale.ai>
Cc: legal@hinsdale.ai
Date: Mon, 7 Jul 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 reference and brief testimonial for case study

Hi all —

Thanks for the heads up. I've reviewed the draft and attached our redlines (Hinsdale_case_study_redlines.pdf). A few items from Legal/Security:

- Approved public attestation wording (use verbatim): "Hinsdale has completed a SOC 2 Type II report conducted by Moss & Oak LLP, covering controls relevant to Security and Availability."
- Please remove any product telemetry numbers (latency, token counts, traffic volumes) and replace with qualitative descriptions.
- The testimonial must be provided by company personnel (Claire or another named employee) and approved by legal before publication.

We can approve the case study with the above edits and the following final quote (approved for publication as-is): "Redwood's inference platform gave us predictable latency and secure handling of inference traffic."

If you are able to incorporate our redlines and send a final doc, we will sign off.

Regards,
Markus Engstrom
Senior Counsel, Legal
Hinsdale AI

[Attachment: Hinsdale_case_study_redlines.pdf (application/pdf)]

Quote used (approved): "Redwood's inference platform gave us predictable latency and secure handling of inference traffic."

Attachments included: final case study and a link to the public attestation page. If you'd prefer the attestation to be a gated download instead of publicly attached, please tell us and we'll make that change before publishing.

Next steps: I'll push the story live on our site on Monday and add it to partner collateral. I'll also send a DocuSign for the brief permissions form so we have a signed record (link below).

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/Signing/?s=ZXlKaGJHY2lPaUpJVXpJMU5pSjku...
